# Breakout, weak side

## Principle
The weak-side winger gives the D an outlet on the wall.

## Cue
When our D has it behind the net, get to the wall at the hashmarks.

## What wrong looks like
Drifting low into the corner leaves the D with no outlet.

## Self-check
At 2.0 s, were you on the wall above the hashmarks?
